content:
“It's all about the close-range spray-and-pray!”

**Guerrilla Expert** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

+3 max Onslaught stacks. +1% reload speed per Onslaught stack.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 2 | +1% reload speed per Onslaught stack, +3 max stacks. | 0031AF04 | 

- Before update 58, Guerrilla Expert was called "Expert Guerrilla," and it provided 10%/15%/20% more damage to automatic pistols per rank.
- Although the perk card art for Expert Guerrilla depicts a MAC-11 pistol, this weapon is not available in the game.

Other reload speed perks include:

- Ground Pounder - rifles
- Gun Tricks - reload speed bonus for ghoul characters
- Lock and Load - reload speed bonus per stack
- Quick Hands - chance to instantly reload magazine
- Wild West Hands - chance to instantly reload magazine for ghoul characters
